companies.name: Alphabet
companies.description: Alphabet is the holding company of Google. Most of its revenue comes from advertising on Google Search and YouTube. It also sells cloud computing through Google Cloud, subscriptions, apps and devices, and funds longer-term businesses such as Waymo.
